new_text: a, Quantitative summary of three evidence classes for the replicated IFN/ISG program. STAT1/STAT2 were positive and passed the global 24-test q<0.05 criterion in all six regulator-by-contrast tests; M5911 normalized enrichment scores exceeded 3.0 in all three contrasts; and all 12 genes increased in each of two IFN-beta-exposed donors. The regulator family provides confirmatory observational evidence, M5911 provides orthogonal response-set concordance and GSE23307 provides descriptive perturbational context. Together these layers support observational convergence but not a causal regulator, direct binding or a uniquely upstream ligand.
